QuestInfo.name: Time Alchemist
QuestInfo.0: #p2400005# and #p2400006# had failed to find the real Goddess Teardrop, and discovered that the Shadow Knights were hot on their tails instead. There wasn't much to be happy about, but a trip to #m326000000# was in order. A girl there named #b#p2460000##k was claiming claims to be the Goddess Teardrop....
QuestInfo.1: #p2460000# devised a test to see if she found #p2400005# and #p2400006# worthy as the Transcendents of Time. They'd have to go along.
QuestInfo.2: #p2460000# was a little strange, but the duo decided to finish her test to get the truth.

0.0: Yes, a test, silly! You have to understand, I've been waiting for you two for a loooong time. I've got this mental image of you built up, and you're going to need to live up to it.
0.1: I need to know that it's going to be worth it to give my life up as Rachel and travel with you two. Can't you see my side of things?

yes.0: I want to know that the #btwo of you are just as strong when you're apart#k. I mean, c'mon. You're always together. Think of this as a chance to get a little fresh air!
yes.1: Let me know whenever you're ready! I'll be waiting.
